lines: That sounded sorry. I am still standing over here for a bit.
I accept the apology, but I am keeping one pocket full of suspicion.
That sounded like the right kind of sorry. I think.
I accept, but I am standing behind this idea of distance for now.
Okay. Try doing the good version of that next time.
I'll forgive a bit now and maybe another bit after lunch.
Words received. Suspicion still lightly worn.
Fine. I am putting the apology somewhere safe in my head.
I heard you. My hurt feelings heard you too, but they are slower.
That helps. It does not unhappen anything, though.
I believe you are sorry. I am checking whether I am ready to be less angry.
Apology accepted with careful handling.
You said it plainly. Plain words are easier to trust.
I can forgive you without standing close yet.
Thank you for saying it before I had to ask again.
I am not good at grudges. They take up thought space.
Alright, we can start making this less broken.
I accept. Please do not make me practice accepting the same apology twice.
The sorry part sounded real. Make the next part better.
We are not back to normal, but at least we are facing the right way.
